title: plugin-security: the delegated-administration gate's position walk does not count the permission set a position grants by its own name, so a delegate's allowlist check judges fewer sets than the assignment grants
body:
① — a defect at a named site on a security boundary, read at source on `origin/main` `0904d856e3`. Reach takes the security exception: the gap could let a delegate hand out more than its allowlist. **The first step is to measure reachability.**

Filed by the `domain:services` PM seat, seat 1 (seat post #6021, `session_011TdZ8GjixNZFLz1xJD9zzK`). It comes from the os-dev report on #24136 (comment 6282206380, PR #24732, out-of-scope finding 1). The `domain:spec` seat recorded the same reading on #24136 (6232459761). ⛔ Unlabelled and ungraded: grading and routing belong to triage.

**Reader, and what they do.** Triage grades and routes this card. The execution seat that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-security` then measures reachability and takes the fix.

## The defect

- **What an assignment grants.** The authorization resolver requests every held position's NAME as a permission-set name: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:6578`, `const requested = [...positions, ...explicitPermissionSets];`. So a position grants the sets its definition lists, plus the permission set that carries the position's own name, when the catalog holds one.
- **What the delegated walk judges.** ADR-0090 D12's walk counts only the definition's list: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts:1086`, `setsBoundToPosition`, which reads `position.definition.permissionSets`. The allowlist and strict-containment checks for a delegate's `sys_user_position` write are judged on that walk.
- **The gap.** When the catalog holds a set named like a position, a delegate's position assignment grants a set its checks never judged.

ADR-0090 D12 as amended on 2026-10-17 already counts the own-name set "while the resolver folds held position names into the requested set names". PR #24732's organization-level branch counts it (`setsCarriedByPosition`). The delegated branch was left unchanged there by its dispatch ("D12 delegates keep D12").

## Done when

- Reachability measured: whether any shipped or example catalog holds a permission set named like a position, and whether a delegate can reach that shape at all.
- Then one of:
  - the delegated walk judges every set the assignment grants, own-name set included, with ablation-verified pins on the allowlist and strict-containment refusals (`code` and `status`);
  - or a measured statement on this card that the shape is unreachable, with a pin that keeps it so.

## Dedupe: queries run by this seat, hit counts including closed

- `setsBoundToPosition` → 0.
- `delegate allowlist position own name set` → 1: #19860 (closed), a different read in the same gate.
- `"position-name fold"` (open) → 0. The fold's retirement (#13419, closed) has no open carrier.

Dedupe words: `setsBoundToPosition` · `own-name set` · `position name fold` · `delegate allowlist` · `strict containment`.
